turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Look: "reads / Lina / books / at night". Who? Lina. Action? reads. What? books. When? at night, so it goes last. Lina reads books at night.
Rule: who comes first, then the action, then the thing, and the time last.
Right: Tom eats bread at night. Wrong: Bread eats Tom at night.
Your turn. Put in order:
"plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
